identity.title: A Simple Sequentially Rejective Multiple Test Procedure

read_extent: Original journal text via mirror, printed pp66-67/Section2, Scheme1/Theorem1/Boole proof. OCR damaged formula typography; local original PDF unavailable. Official publisher/JSTOR issue records verify publication identity.
claim: Holm presents a sequentially rejective Bonferroni multiple-test procedure with familywise type-I error protection over arbitrary true-null subsets. Its Boole-inequality argument requires valid marginal tests; it does not require independence among the six contrast p-values and cannot repair invalid single-test p-values.
limits: Directed source reading only, no formal measurements or unconditional cross-root dependence guarantee. Independent review pending.
